documents.text: Account recovery uses the recovery page. Verify your identity before you change the account email.
Refund status appears in the billing settlement record. A pending refund shows a settlement reference.
A password reset link works once and stops working after one hour. Request one fresh reset link and discard the old link.
Order tracking shows carrier scans. A parcel without a recent scan can receive a carrier trace.
Sign-in security codes depend on an accurate device clock. Synchronize the clock before you retry the code.
Invoices list service lines and totals. Send a duplicate service line on an invoice to billing review.
A refund for a returned parcel starts after the parcel is scanned at the returns desk. Check the parcel scan, not the refund page.
Expired passwords must be changed at sign-in. When your password has expired, the sign-in page asks you to choose a new password.
